Your Warwick project

Make the entryway, kitchen, and living space work together.

For a Warwick home where the entry leads directly into living space, think about the floor as a connected route. Door clearance, transitions, wet shoes, and everyday cleaning matter alongside the look of the boards. We can discuss hardwood, LVP, or tile based on the rooms in your project.

If the plan includes a kitchen, show us the appliance openings and the edges at cabinets and adjoining rooms. Finished floor height and the order of the work need attention before selecting a product. Include those details in the estimate instead of deciding them during installation.

Before your walkthrough

  • Show the path from the entry to the rooms being updated.
  • Note appliance openings and doors with limited clearance.
  • Tell us about pets, cleaning habits, and daily foot traffic.

Answers before you start

Warwick flooring questions.

Have a question about your own rooms? Ask for a callback.

Should I choose hardwood or LVP for my Warwick home?

The right choice depends on the room, existing subfloor, moisture conditions, maintenance preferences, and the product's installation requirements. Hardwood and LVP have different strengths. We can discuss both during a walkthrough without choosing from appearance alone.

Can you carry one floor through adjoining rooms?

We can assess that layout. Subfloor condition, changes in floor height, product requirements, and the length of the run determine where transitions are needed. Doorways and appliance clearances should be part of the plan.

Does a water-resistant floor solve a damp subfloor?

No. The condition beneath the flooring still needs attention, and the chosen product's requirements must be met. Tell us about leaks or recurring dampness before the estimate so the preparation and any work needed first can be discussed.

Can I request bathroom tile and flooring in the same estimate?

Yes. Describe both areas when you contact us. We can review the bathroom tile and flooring work together, with the preparation and finish details identified for each area in the written scope.

Is the in-home estimate in Warwick free?

Yes. We offer a free in-home estimate. After reviewing the space and your project, we provide a written, itemized scope so you can see what is included before work begins.

How do I request a callback?

Use the form on this page with your name, phone number, town, and project type. You can include a preferred call time. We will contact you about the project and confirm next steps; the requested time is a preference, not a booked appointment. You can also call (401) 602-0958.
